verdict.rationale: Typesense Cloud has a public pricing calculator page referencing dedicated clusters, no record/operation limits, and add-ons like GPU acceleration and HA (typesense-docs-19–23), implying usage-based cost inputs exist, but no evidence shows actual per-unit dollar rates (e.g., $/search, $/GB, $/node-hour) that a founder could use to predict costs upfront. Missing for 10: explicit published unit prices or rate tables, worked cost examples, and any confirmation the calculator outputs concrete dollar figures rather than just feature toggles.
